inputs.label: Unreal Tournament (1999, GOTY or standard)
inputs.help: Your own PC copy of Unreal Tournament from GOG, Steam, CD-ROM or an archive. QGPUI copies System, Maps, Textures, Sounds and Music.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.ghwstvr.ut99quest/files on the first launch.

steps.text: Open UT99 Quest from Library > Unknown Sources. On the first start it downloads and applies the OldUnreal 469 patch, with a progress bar. Keep Wi-Fi on.

notes: The APK is a fixed URL on the author's site, so QGPUI cannot tell its version before downloading. Music is optional in the payload; the Music glob may match nothing. The GOG install folder name is a guess. The guide also allows a UT99 folder or zip in /sdcard/UT99Quest/ with the in-headset importer. The launch is assumed to be needed for the Android/data folder; the guide does not say so.
